title: Not terribly stable
text:
Not terribly stable. I want to love this hall rack. It looks nice and has lots of designated space for storage of random items. Unfortunately, this is not really sturdy and it wobbles. The connecting pieces are not strong themselves and that definitely leads to instability once this is put together.

I am using it in my office as a decorative piece for light jackets, extra shoes and my tote bag of files and field use laptop etc. I keep an extra pair of heels, mud boots and steel toe shoes in my office because I never know for sure where my day will take me. This unit handles that stuff fine and it hasn't fallen apart. However, if you have a busy home with kids tossing book bags and shoes etc on it multiple times a day, this thing may not survive long.
